plan_text:
# Implementation Plan: one view of the sheet for the program example's captions (340)

**Spec**: `spec.md` (FAITHFUL, round 2) | **Measurements**: `harness.py` (`make spec-harness SPEC=specs/340-program-example-captions-hand-sheet-placer OUT=<json>`)

## Summary

Three steps, as the spec orders them: the composed draft declares its captions the hand sheets' way (additive - no seat
moves); a harness measures, on that one declared draft, every caption the composer and the hand-sheet placer seat
differently, attributing each to the entry's three sources and reporting what each of the entry's two fixes removes; then the
seating switches to the fix the measurement supports, per source, keeping feature 287's strict rule. D3 is decided by the
measurement and the plan is amended and re-reviewed before it is built.

## Decisions

- **D1 - the declarations (FR-001)**: `emit_svg`'s `rect` gains a `data-id` argument and `caption` a `names` argument; the
  written caption carries `data-names` listing the drawn shapes it names. Each call site names the shape(s) the caption is
  about: a zone's, a building's or a room's own rect; the dais and each clerk's seat; the bath, a well, a latrine, every tub, the
  notice board; EVERY straw mat (the hand sheets' form: the caption names all the mats of its group - plan review round 1:
  naming only the last mat would hide the entry's 'one mat' difference before D2 measures it); the striking posts' two circles. Where the composer seats a caption on ground that
  is not a drawn shape (a block's name in its rear alley, `_rear_band`), the declaration names the block itself - that IS the
  subject difference the entry names, and the harness counts it. No invisible stand-in is added (the entry counts those as a
  difference). Nothing else changes: the composer still seats by its own subjects, so every seat is unchanged and a test
  asserts the declared draft's caption positions equal the undeclared draft's.
- **D2 - the harness (FR-002)**: on the declared draft, `C` = the composer's seats as emitted, `H` = `labels.hand_sheet.seat` on
  the same text. Variants of the composer's seating, each one source swapped for the hand-sheet placer's: the obstacle view
  (`hand_sheet.classify` over the drawn sheet less its captions, in place of `emit_svg`'s own obstacle list and the roofed
  court's late obstacles), the subject (`hand_sheet.subjects` over the declared parts), the width (`char_w_of` per caption in
  place of `CHAR_W_EM`); and the two fixes as the entry words them - fix 1 the composer indexing with `classify` (its own
  subjects), fix 2 the hand-sheet placer taking the composer's subjects. For each caption whose `C` and `H` differ by more than
  1 px it records the sources that remove the difference; one no source removes is reported with its cause (strictness, order,
  clearance, repair) and kept out of N. Recorded in `measurements.json`.
- **D3 - the switch (FR-003)**, decided by D2's measurement (m:caption-disagreements, re-run 2026-10-11 after plan review round
  2: every variant now tries a caption's subjects in order, the first with a free seat winning, as `hand_sheet.seat` does): of
  45 captions, 11 seat apart; 10 are explained by the three sources - the obstacle VIEW alone 5 (garden, straw mats, practice
  ground, two wells), the SUBJECT alone 2 (the residence; the fire-water tubs, which the composer names by the roomiest tub
  where the declaration names all of them), the three TOGETHER 3 (gatehouse, cell, one clerk); WIDTH alone moves none. Fix 1
  (the composer indexing with `classify`) removes 5; fix 2 (the hand-sheet placer taking the composer's subjects) removes 2.
  The switch takes, per source: VIEW - fix 1: `emit_svg` builds each caption's index with `hand_sheet.classify` over the sheet
  it has drawn (its captions not yet written), the seated captions added as now, and no obstacle list or late obstacles of its
  own; SUBJECT - the composer takes the hand-sheet placer's reading of the declared subject, `hand_sheet.subjects` over the
  declared parts, the whole ordered list tried as the hand-sheet placer tries it (inside, then beside; the first with a free
  seat wins), since the composer's own single subject is what differs; WIDTH - the composer measures each caption with
  `hand_sheet.char_w_of` (FR-003: the source no longer differs, though on this example it moves no seat). Measured with all
  three swapped: 44 of 45 agree; the one left apart is a clerk (order, clearance or repair - not one of the three), reported
  and not unified; and every caption finds a strict seat (none soft). After the switch the harness re-runs on the built code.
- **D4 - strictness under the one view (FR-004)**: a seat is free when it touches nothing outside the caption's declared parts:
  every weighted obstacle `classify` gives blocks, the ones it flags `inner` (partitions, a court's buildings, a named room
  inside the subject) included - a caption named for a building does not name its partitions (plan review round 2 reversed the
  first D4, which let inner ink through). The placer's own `blocked` already waives the subject's own outline. Foot growth
  (`CAPTION_GROWTHS`) and the refusal message are unchanged; the growth and refusal run only when no subject in the list has a
  free seat.
- **D5 - performance (FR-005)**: the example's gen timed before and after (`make map ... PROFILE=1`); `make perf-report` read;
  any band crossed explained and audited.
- **D6 - tests**: `tests/test_compound.py` keeps its refusal test unchanged; a declarations test (D1, seats unchanged); the D3
  switch's tests as D3 settles them, with 100% coverage of what changes.

## Constitution Check

- XVI literal: the entry's "measure first which disagreements each removes" is D2, run before D3 is chosen.
- XIII/XIV: the refusal test and the pool sheet's checks hold; any finding the re-seating causes is fixed here.
- VI: D5.
- Occasions: `layout-revised: county-magistracy-example` (its captions re-seated) - one `building-review` after D3 lands.

decisions.summary: rect gains data-id, caption gains names/data-names; each caption names its zone/building/room rect, dais, each clerk's seat, bath/well/latrine/every tub/board, EVERY straw mat, the striking posts' two circles; rear-alley captions name the block; no stand-ins; seats unchanged, held by a test (built, 1eec1030f).
decisions.why: FR-001. Round 1's D1-mats item is resolved: the mats caption now names every mat (compound.py names=drawn[first:]), the hand sheets' form; 'every tub' likewise. The figure m:caption-disagreements reproduces (11 apart, 6/5/1/0, fix 1 5, fix 2 2) on re-run.

decisions.summary: Harness: C vs H on the declared draft; one-source-swapped composer variants (view, subject, width) and the entry's two fixes; differences over 1 px attributed, the rest reported with cause.
decisions.why: FR-002 as worded. Round 2's departure in the built harness is fixed: harness.py line 78 now takes the whole ordered hand_sheet.subjects list and seat_loop tries it in order (first free seat wins, else least cost), as one() does. The module docstring (line 15) still says 'first subject' - stale words, not the code. m:caption-disagreements re-run this round: 45 captions, 11 apart, 10 explained (view 5, subject 2, width 0, 3 together), fix 1 5, fix 2 2, after the switch apart [clerk], soft [] - reproduces. Fix the docstring with the next harness edit.

decisions.summary: Fix 1: emit_svg builds each caption's index with hand_sheet.classify over the drawn sheet, no obstacle list or late obstacles of its own; seated captions added as now.
decisions.why: The entry's fix 1, supported by the measurement. Seated captions 'as now' (not the hand sheet's WEIGHT_TEXT plus keep) is the clearance difference FR-003 leaves out of scope.

decisions.summary: The composer takes hand_sheet.subjects over the declared parts as the WHOLE ordered list, tried as the hand-sheet placer tries it (inside, then beside; the first with a free seat wins).
decisions.why: Round-2 item resolved. This is the subject as hand_sheet.seat's one() reads it (subjects(own, size) in order, break on cost 0), which is what FR-003 unifies; the harness's SUBJECT and ALL variants measure exactly that, so the figure and the switch now describe the same thing.

decisions.summary: The composer measures each caption with hand_sheet.char_w_of (the source no longer differs, though on this example it moves no seat).
decisions.why: Round-2 item resolved: FR-003's 'so the three sources no longer differ' and User Story 1's one measure of width are now carried; zero moved seats is reported as a fact about the example, not used to keep CHAR_W_EM.

decisions.summary: From the corrected harness: 10 of 11 disagreements explained by the three sources; with all three swapped 44 of 45 agree; the one left apart (a clerk, order/clearance/repair) is reported, not unified; none soft.
decisions.why: Round-2 item resolved: N and the residual set now come from the re-run with the full ordered subject list (re-run by this review, figures reproduce), and agree with my round-2 independent check (only one clerk stays apart). Leaving order, clearance and repair un-unified is FR-003's own last sentence, and the one residual is measured to be outside the three (the ALL variant does not remove it).

decisions.summary: A seat is free when it touches nothing outside the caption's declared parts: every weighted obstacle classify gives blocks, inner ones (partitions, a court's buildings, a named room inside the subject) included; blocked() waives the subject's own (non-inner) outline; growth and refusal unchanged, run only when no subject in the list has a free seat.
decisions.why: Round-2 item (inner ink let through) is resolved, but the amended rule is not what its mechanism does. Its first clause - free when the seat 'touches nothing outside the caption's declared parts' - is FR-004 and User Story 2 ('judged against the ink a caption does NOT name, never against its own parts'). Its mechanism - 'every weighted obstacle classify gives blocks, the ones it flags inner included', with only the subject's own outline waived by blocked() (obstacles.py line 258: a non-inner part_of the subject) - also blocks a DECLARED shape that classify flags inner. Measured this round (a probe run through make spec-harness on the declared draft, every hand_sheet.subjects entry of every caption): the striking posts caption, whose declaration names both circles (D1), is tried against its one subject (beside, the box of the two), and classify flags both circles inner at full weight, so the plan judges that caption against the two posts it names. No other caption on this example is affected (mats and tubs not). Not necessary: waiving a declared shape is one membership test, and the plan's own first clause already states it. Fix: D4 states that a shape the caption declares never makes its seat unfree even where classify flags it inner, and every other weighted obstacle, inner or not, does; the harness's VIEW and ALL variants take the same view, and D3's after-switch figures (44 of 45, none soft) are re-measured under it. If the author holds that declared-inner shapes must block (the hand-sheet placer's behavior), that is an exception to User Story 2 and goes through an EXCEPTION CHECK, not into the plan unlabeled.

decisions.summary: Gen timed before and after, perf-report read, any band crossed explained and audited.
Refusal test unchanged; declarations test (seats unchanged); D3's tests at 100% coverage.
decisions.why: SC-002 and FR-001; tests that enforce what was asked.

decisions.summary: T01-T04 map D1, D2, D3+D4, D5 and the Occasions' building-review; D3 amended and re-reviewed before T03.
decisions.why: Mirror the plan; no task adds or drops scope.
